sources.title: The ATLAS Experiment at the CERN Large Hadron Collider
facts: Barrel: 8 coils, 120 turns/coil, 20.5 kA, 1.08 GJ, 3.9 T peak winding field.
Each endcap: 8 coils, 116 turns/coil, 20.5 kA, 0.25 GJ, 4.1 T peak.
Coil and steel geometry enter the detailed field calculation.
MDT chambers use two3/4-plane multilayers of30mm tubes; listed spacer heights range6.5–317mm, guiding a provisional500mm chamber-outline scale.

sources.title: The superconducting magnet system for the ATLAS detector at CERN
sources.authors: P. Miele and H. H. J. ten Kate
facts: Eight coils per toroid; endcaps rotated 22.5 degrees relative to the barrel.
Each barrel racetrack has an individual vessel; each endcap contains a common cold assembly and vessel.
Windings use aluminium-stabilized NbTi/Cu and forced-flow helium cooling.

facts: Coils approximately 25 m long, 5 m wide and 0.4 m thick.
Two double-pancake windings are held in an aluminium-alloy casing.

The endcaps are separate integrated cold assemblies and cryostats.

claims.derivation: 360 degrees/(2*12); analogue of the ATLAS half-sector offset.
claims.limits: Not an ATLAS dimension or optimized nODD rotation.

claims.claim: Ideal toroidal mean field needs about 2.42 MA-turn per coil for 1 T at radius 5.8 m with twelve coils.
claims.limits: Ampere scale only; finite-coil field, ripple and performance require calculation.

claims.claim: Independent 35 and 30 micrometre station errors give 46.0977 micrometres effective uncertainty.
claims.limits: Independent alignment is a study assumption, retained from the central PR86 comparison; section 2 gives 40 micrometres for ATLAS endcaps. Do not add the single-tube error again.

claims.claim: Pinned PR86 requires 0.860806 T across 3 m for 10% standalone resolution at local 500 GeV under its stated proxy assumptions.
claims.limits: Not a minimum field from the combined target: its tracker proxy alone gives 6.75%. Not an installed-device result.

claims.claim: Pinned solenoid has winding radii 1.3278 to 1.3792706602 m, length 7.2 m and 18.363595673 MA-turn at central 3 T.
claims.limits: 143.1737575 MJ/4.7724586 m3 vacuum result does not certify installed coupled energy.

claims.claim: Use twelve barrel racetracks and twelve in each endcap, with coil-following cryostat reservations and three nested barrel/disk outline stations.
claims.rationale: Human-requested topology, PR86 compact-span benchmark and ATLAS air-core precedent.
claims.limits: Unsigned prototype; dimensions and currents belong to the final configuration, not to ATLAS facts.

claims.claim: First deliver a joint solenoid-plus-toroid coil field with all media assigned vacuum permeability.
claims.rationale: A reproducible initial field calculation is possible before HCAL magnetic-grade and B-H data exist.
claims.limits: HCAL material remains steel geometrically. This is not the installed nonlinear field, energy or cold-volume compliance certification.
